text:
Bounded acceptance. No high or medium defect is present in the embedded adapter.

This is a static review of the embedded bytes. Payload layout was re-derived from the pinned codec and the Python serializer. SHA-256 was not recomputed, and the frozen tests were not re-executed.

## Verdict

`projectSource6Definition`, `encodeSource6Definition`, and `compareSource6DefinitionContent` admit only a primitive string, call `parseSource6`, and project a frozen nine-field purpose-1 definition. The recorded transfer and repayment images match that layout. The 50-test TAP record matches the test source. Authentication, a full consumer, ledger admission, and Sprint 1 closure stay outside this result.

## Nine fields

| Field | Origin in the embedded code |
| --- | --- |
| `sourceVersion=6` | `SOURCE_IMAGE_SUITE` constant. Absent from `Source6Ast`. |
| `profile` | `ast.profile`, stamped only after the raw token equals `"moriarty-financial-agreement-source/6"`. |
| `wireProfile=1` | Suite constant. `Source6Ast` has no such member. A source field `wire_profile` fails `SOURCE6_SHAPE`. |
| `agreementInstanceId` | `id('agreement', ast.programId)`, the name after `agreement`. |
| `domain` | `id('domain', ast.domain)` |
| `asset` | `id('asset', ast.settlement.asset)` |
| `scale` | `ast.settlement.scale`, canonical decimal; codec writes one byte, maximum 18. |
| `selectedActionId` | `id('action', ast.selected.actionId)` |
| `operationKind` | `ast.intent.signedAction.kind` |

`lowerSource6` stores the builtin on the lowered intent as `programId`. The adapter reads the AST agreement name instead. The formed parser returns a pair only when the selector matches the signed kind (`TransferLiteralFee`/`Transfer`, `RepayAccrualFirst`/`Repay`). The codec checks that pair again.

`SOURCE_IMAGE_SUITE` is frozen as `{sourceVersion:6, wireProfile:1, profile:'moriarty-financial-agreement-source/6', purpose:1}`. Encode and compare both pass purpose 1. Callers have no version, wire-profile, purpose, or digest argument.

## Content bytes

Envelope is `moriarty-mil4-image/1\0 || purpose 1 || uint32be(length)` (27 bytes). Payload is `version 6 || u16-profile || wire 1 || u16-agreement || u16-domain || u16-asset || scale byte || u16-selector || kind`.

- Transfer, 81-byte payload, kind byte `01`, selector `TransferLiteralFee`: digest `01f54eeb2a1ff0dd9808e901c03716022b99f07b6ae360b7ec5a0fcec83df20a`
- Repay, 80-byte payload, kind byte `02`, selector `RepayAccrualFirst`: digest `c71215c155d569f53c0fbb309eb0e1ac5cc829fa2d83bacdf395a104ee82c45d`

Those payload hex values match `vectors.json`, `result-data.json`, and the codec `sourcePayload` rules. The ASCII claims `claim-source` and `claim-policy` are absent from both payloads. The same digests appear in `run-results.json` and `RESULT.md`. Python is a second serializer of the declared fixture fields, as the plan describes.

## Admission, invariance, and the caller boundary

Text admission is the embedded parser. Exact raw profile, canonical integers, scale `0..18`, reserved identifiers, cell shape, obligation `principal+accrued=outstanding`, trailing source, comments, size (`>65536` UTF-8 bytes), and lone surrogates all fail inside `parseSource6` before a definition exists. The current test expects `INVALID_INTEGER` for `scale 00`, which is the lexer code in the embedded frontend.

Claims, intent key/nonce, authenticated round/work, comments, whitespace, and submitted effect amounts are unread by the projection. A debit change can remain formed and keep the original image. The retained test `stage/effect rejection is outside successful source formation` records `CoreRejected` from `prepareSource6S0Unqualified` for that case. The adapter never calls the preparer.

`typeof source !== 'string'` runs before any read. The export list is the suite constant, the error class, and the three string functions. Proxy, boxed string, null, number, and `Symbol.toPrimitive` inputs take `SOURCE_TEXT_REQUIRED`. Comparison calls projection first, so malformed source fails before `hash32`. Results keep `scope:"content-only"` and `authenticated:false`.

## Records and dependency pins

`adapter.test.mjs` contains 50 tests. `test-results.tap` is `1..50`, pass 50, fail 0, skipped 0, and the subtest names match the source in order. `artifact-manifest.json` records the same counts. `result-data.json` and `run-results.json` agree on status `local-source-image-experiment-not-adopted`, six verified inputs, and both digests.

Pinned hashes that also appear on the embedded files:

- `hash-image-codec/codec.mjs`: 23537 bytes, `a94edacb2f1e81e03bc930d3f7921358e6b3c59b1b8ff1e25532f810874b4d62`
- `financial-agreement-source-v6-frontend.ts`: 20746 bytes, `f3d2a05d07b051d2097fd7fb00ed1cd013eba91e9da7a2591b6f69707d4a02e7`

`protected-inputs.json` (`9766c0718ac7f3ea0b9b0e9b334d8c7a648ffbb67a05824593047aa3dc9468e2`) matches the outer manifest and `result-data.json`.

## Acceptance bounds

The image is selected-definition content. Equal images still allow different intent parameters, snapshots, claims, and submitted effects, including a formed source that Core preparation rejects. Nominal sorts are checked and then omitted from the bytes; position distinguishes the identifiers. Image buffers stay mutable caller copies. The `.d.mts` file has no separate TypeScript compile in this packet. `codec.d.mts`, `mil4-s0-core-v5.ts`, `mil4-s0-source-v6.ts`, and the grammar are pin-only here. `initial-test-results.tap` and `expected-code-failure.tap` are named in `artifact-manifest.json` and are outside the embedded set, so the red-green history is unchecked. The packet does not establish B01/B05, provider authentication, a full consumer, ledger admission, or Sprint 1 closure.
